scenario.summary: SafePay ransomware actors gain initial access through VPN vulnerabilities, brute-force, or phishing, subsequently establishing persistence via account creation and privilege manipulation. They move laterally using LOLBins and RMM tools like ScreenConnect and AnyDesk, before exfiltrating data via cloud-sync utilities and deploying ransomware that encrypts files with a .SafePay extension and disables recovery mechanisms.

meta.rationale: Start the hunt by examining workstations with internet-facing RMM tools installed, then widen the scope if rare sign-ins to file servers are detected from those hosts.
meta.hypothesis: SafePay actors have established a foothold and are using repurposed administrative tools, credential dumpers, and anomalous RDP or SMB sessions to move laterally toward file shares.

rmm_tools.description: RMM package or vendor names mentioned in SafePay reporting.

blind_spots.risk: A host without an agent allows an actor to run NetExec or Mimikatz invisibly at the host level; lateral movement would only be visible at the authentication source.
blind_spots.question: Are there internal servers performing network discovery that are not reporting process activity?
blind_spots.requires: Endpoint agent coverage on all internal servers

blind_spots.risk: SafePay uses ShareFinder.ps1 for AD enumeration. If the actor loads the script content directly into memory, hb_process_activity may only see the powershell.exe launch, not the specific recon commands.
blind_spots.question: Was the ShareFinder.ps1 function run in-memory without a script file?

hunt.name: SafePay: Internal Enumeration and Lateral Movement
hunt.description: SafePay actors rely on legitimate tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) for persistence and open-source scripts (ShareFinder, NetExec) for network discovery. This hunt identifies the presence of these RMM tools, detects the execution of common enumeration binaries at elevated integrity, and baselines internal authentication to find rare lateral movement paths. An agent weighs the findings to determine if an actor is actively traversing the estate.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, vendor_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (instr(',' || '{{rmm_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(vendor_name) || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify hosts where AnyDesk, TeamViewer or ScreenConnect are installed, establishing the initial search scope.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts containing RMM tools. Silence means no such software was recorded in the latest snapshot.

nodes.label: SafePay discovery and bypass tool execution

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_original_file_name, process_cmd_line, integrity_level, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{recon_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{recon_tools}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%sharefinder%') AND integrity_level IN ('High', 'System') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the execution of binaries for share discovery and UAC bypass, filtering for high-integrity launches that indicate successful elevation.
config.expected_signal: Process events for SharpShares, Mimikatz, or PsExec running with high integrity. Silence confirms these specific binaries did not run at high integrity on enrolled hosts.

primitive_config.expected: Process events for SharpShares, Mimikatz, or PsExec running with high integrity. Silence confirms these specific binaries did not run at high integrity on enrolled hosts.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname, logon_type, COUNT(*) AS logins, MIN(time) AS first_login FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status = 'Success' AND logon_type_id IN (3, 10) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname HAVING logins < 15
config.description: Baseline internal sign-ins to identify rare lateral movement paths using RDP or SMB that differ from normal admin patterns.
config.expected_signal: A few hosts showing rare incoming sessions from internal source IPs. Silence indicates no new or low-volume lateral paths were observed.

config.objective: Determine if the presence of AnyDesk/TeamViewer, the high-integrity execution of SharpShares or NetExec, and the rare internal sign-ins indicate an active SafePay intrusion.
config.description: Analyze the RMM inventory, the elevated tools, and the rare sign-ins together to distinguish authorized admin work from a SafePay actor.
config.expected_signal: A verdict per host citing the tool and the lateral session that confirms it.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign citing specific rows from the tool and auth queries.

config.question: the weigh-evidence verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the weigh-evidence verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Isolate the host if the agent determines the activity is malicious.
Contain the threat to prevent further lateral spread or file share enumeration.
config.instructions: Isolate the hosts identified as malicious and terminate any active RDP or WinRM sessions for the involved users.

config.description: Verify the agent's findings and pivot to file activity to check for data staging.
config.instructions: Review the cited process and sign-in logs. Check hb_file_activity for bulk access to sensitive shares from the compromised hosts during the time window.

config.description: Document whether the tools were authorized and promote the detection query if unauthorized use was confirmed.
config.instructions: Record the findings. If SharpShares or NetExec execution was confirmed as unauthorized, promote the recon-tool-execution query to a standing rule.
